source.title: Honey badger
source.quote: The mean weight of adult honey badgers from different areas has been reported at anywhere between 6.4 to 12 kg (14 to 26 lb), with a median of roughly 9 kg (20 lb), per various studies.

mass_kg.note: Adult honey badgers of both sexes, from different areas. Value is the median the source states; low and high are the range of reported means. Males in Africa are heavier (9 to 16 kg).

size_m.note: Body length without the tail; the source does not split by sex. Upper end of the stated range; the source gives no mean.

top_speed_mps.note: No citable measured top speed found in the approved sources. Category default; one of the honey badger's 3 allowed estimates (D-47).

attack_force_n.note: force = 50.57 x mass_kg^0.6072, the average carnivore canine bite for this mass, computed in code by app.research.bite_force from the 31 living species in Wroe et al. 2005 Table 1 (https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC1564077/). Range is +/-50%.

attacks_per_s.note: No published attack rate found for this animal; category default.

reach_m.note: reach = 0.25 x size_m (lunging bite), from size_m.

endurance_s.note: No published figure for how long it can keep fighting; category default.

aggression_0_1.note: aggression level 5: attacks animals larger than itself.

group_tactics_0_1.note: group tactics level 1: solitary, fights alone.
